narrative.intro: BP Oil International has $379M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. BP Oil International received 8 awards in the current fiscal period, with an average award size of $47.4M. BP Oil International recorded obligations in FY21, FY22, FY23, FY24, and FY26 as shown by fiscal-year totals. FY21 obligations were $169M, FY22 obligations were $243M, FY23 obligations were $21.3M, FY24 obligations were $18.4M, and FY26 obligations were $379M. The current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date figures. The numbers here refer to contract obligations unless a specific table lists award-value figures as total contract values.
